messages:
marta: Hey @sam — heads up: AcmeReg needs an on‑prem POC but they are fully air‑gapped and insist on offline installers + no outbound connections. They also asked about upgrade cadence (they want monthly security patches) and licensing: are we doing reserved capacity or a perpetual package for this?

sam: Thanks, Marta. Timeline is tight — they want a 2‑week POC starting next month. Main asks: signed offline bundle, SBOM for the delivered artifacts, offline license activation (no callback), and a small delta update story so they don't re‑transfer 20GB every time. Also price sensitivity — they'll prefer a one‑time license + support unless the reserved model improves unit cost. Can engineering confirm feasibility?

vincent: Feasibility check: yes we can produce an offline bundle (signed tarball + signed manifest). Options: full image (OCI tar) or a packaged VM appliance. For monthly security patches we recommend quarterly security rollups by default — monthly is doable but adds operational overhead and will likely incur an ops/support surcharge.

vincent: For updates, we have two paths: 1) full bundle replacement (simplest, robust for airgapped) or 2) delta patching using binary diffs (rsync/bsdiff style) to keep transfer sizes small. Delta patches are doable but need extra validation tooling and will increase testing matrix across their host OS variants.

elaine: From security/compliance: we need to supply SBOMs (CycloneDX), signed artifacts (PKI), and an audit trail for install/upgrade steps. Customer requires evidence of vulnerability scanning and that we support FIPS crypto mode and KMS/HSM integration for key material. Offline license activation must support signed license blobs that their HSM can validate; we cannot rely on Internet activation.

chris: For the POC plan I suggest: week 0 — produce an offline dev bundle + sample SBOM and signed manifest; week 1 — deploy in their lab, exercise install and baseline inference; week 2 — deliver a small delta patch exercise and capture logs/steps. We'll include 8 support hours and a runbook. If they want monthly patches we should quote a managed patching add‑on.

marta: @chris can you draft an initial quote we can share? Markup on one‑time license + 12 months support vs reserved capacity pricing (monthly commit) would help the buyer weigh options. Also they asked about upgrade window: they can only schedule maintenance windows once per month for 2 hours. Does our installer support noninteractive upgrades in that window?

vincent: Noninteractive upgrades are supported via our CLI installer: `redwood-install --apply --manifest signed-manifest.json --mode unattended`. For large model weights we can provide a model‑only delta (weights diffs) but note that many quantized formats don't compress well via diffs; often shipping the new model file is simpler. For 2‑hour windows, test that model downloads + unpacking fit. If model transfer >2GB on their network we should do pre‑staged media (USB) or extend window.

elaine: Also add: we will provide a security questionnaire template response (SOC2 points, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS options). We'll need an NDA redline for them to accept before delivering signed artifacts.

sam: Good — they also asked about license revocation and emergency patches. Can we push a critical CVE patch as an emergency offline bundle?

vincent: Yes, emergency offline bundles are standard. We have a process to build and sign emergency patches and ship them as an urgent tarball. SLA for emergency packaging will be separate — usually 48–72 hours depending on severity and testing.

chris: Pricing note: delta patch engineering and custom packaging (VM appliance, signed installer adaptations) are typically a one‑time professional services line item. Reserve capacity / committed model credits can be added if they want predictable throughput for production after POC. I'll add that to the quote.

marta: Next actions: @chris draft quote with both licensing options + PS line item for delta work; @elaine start the security questionnaire draft; @vincent prepare a small demo offline bundle and sample delta for the POC. I'll coordinate scheduling with AcmeReg. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Uploaded artifact `acmereg-poc-bundle-v0.1.tgz` to internal-artifacts (signed), checksum: sha256:abcd...

sam: Perfect — I'll push to the buyer and aim to lock dates this week. Thanks all.
